question: Carlos took \(70\%\) of a whole pie. Maria took one third of the remainder. What portion of the whole pie was left?
solution:
Maria takes a third of the remainder, so first determine how much Carlos leaves. The portion remaining after Carlos takes his share is
\[
100\%-70\%=30\%=\frac{3}{10}
\]
of the whole pie. Maria then takes
\[
\frac13\cdot\frac{3}{10}=\frac{1}{10}=10\%
\]
of the whole pie. Thus the portion left is
\[
30\%-10\%=\boxed{20\%},
\]
which is choice \(\textbf{C}\).
